description: Single-server research simulation configured to run at full load or pause, for the reference-house examples.

energy_kwh_per_work_unit.source: labelled placeholder: CPU laptop value, config/jobs/research-sim-montecarlo.json. Own measurement 2026-11-21, Intel Core Ultra 7 255H laptop (Windows 11, Docker Desktop), --cpus 8, 8 workers, 320 tasks per run; run 2 (steady state) of data/raw/measurements/research-sim-ising/energy-2026-11-21, docs/jobs/research-sim.md (whole laptop, gross, battery meter: 1.3089 Wh / 320 tasks). TODO(source): no GPU measurement of this job exists

min_s.source: TODO(source): lower end of the '<1 min' bin; Alibaba trace bin edge only, 1 s is an assumption

max_s.source: TODO(source): upper end of the '>3 d' bin; 7 days is an assumption, the trace gives no upper edge

size.source: Alibaba PAI GPU cluster trace 2020, task durations per bin, share of tasks (data/derived/demand/job-durations.csv; data/raw/demand-traces/alibaba-gpu-2020/SOURCE.md, https://github.com/alibaba/clusterdata/tree/master/cluster-trace-gpu-v2020, Weng et al., NSDI 2022, retrieved 2026-11-21; TODO(licence) before redistribution). Log-uniform within a bin. Converted to tasks at load 1 on a 1 kW server: tasks = duration_s x 1 / (kWh per task x 3600 s/h / 1 kW) = duration_s x 67.92 tasks/s, so a job's server-hours equal its duration in hours

batch_size.source: docs/model/fleet-simulation.md section 5.2: batch size 1 for research jobs

max_chunks.source: User requirement: keep each research job on one server.

min_chunk_work_units.source: one simulation task is the split granularity (docs/model/fleet-simulation.md section 5.2)

start_overhead_s.source: TODO(source): container start time not sourced; 0 = not modelled

min_load.source: User-selected full-load-or-paused scenario assumption; TODO(source): minimum sustainable load is not measured.

lifecycle.source: allow_pause: interruptible = true in config/jobs/research-sim-montecarlo.json; checkpointable: each task result is written atomically, progress survives a kill (docs/jobs/research-sim.md)

input_mb_per_work_unit.source: TODO(source): input data size not in the repo; 0 = not modelled (not used by the engine)

state_mb.source: TODO(source): checkpoint size not in the repo; 0 = not modelled (not used by the engine)

placement_policy.source: config/jobs/research-sim-montecarlo.json: demo workload only (synthetic 2D Ising model), no personal data and no customer contract; a real customer job must carry the policy from its contract (decision 0013)

server_hours_per_year.source: cd-d-scicore-sh-energy (data/raw/market/compute-demand.csv): sciCORE Basel consumption in 1 kW server-hour equivalents, energy basis 79,920 (low), central value 80,000 (docs/research/demand.md section on research demand)

volume_scale.source: scenario value: reference volume, no scaling

arrival_shape.source: Alibaba PAI GPU cluster trace 2020, task arrivals per hour of week (data/raw/demand-traces/alibaba-gpu-2020/SOURCE.md, retrieved 2026-11-21); a hyperscaler's internal ML platform, not academic research compute

client_site_share.source: scenario value: research jobs have no data-origin constraint (placement anywhere)

price.source: quoted per billed server-hour by the pricing function (docs/model/fleet-simulation.md section 7)
